body:
I ordered 2 grams of 2-MMC crystals from some Dutch site to just have some fun with my friends for the weekend, it took like 4 days to come, and I am very excited for this shit, decided to write a report since I didn't find much information about it and thought it would be helpful for people that are interested in trying it.
!!Reminder, I ordered to Czech Republic, where 2-MMC is legal, please, before buying 2-MMC or any other research substances, always check the legality status of the chemical in your country!!
Made a dollar-like snuffer from a piece of paper, and got ready.
T+0:00 - Insufflated approximately 70mg of 2-MMC, Gotta say, this stuff really burns like crazy, I almost threw up because a large piece that wasn't crushed well flew straight into my throat and scratched it lol. The taste is very bitter, very chemical of course, and surprisingly kind of sweet, I don't find it that unpleasant.
T+0:05- Starting to feel a little stimulated and euphoric, nothing crazy so far though, but I definitely feel it coming up. Also a little dizzy because of my blurry vision. Eh, I don't mind it that much.
T+0:10 - Damn. It is hitting! And its hitting surprisingly great! Haven't had that much experience with stimulants, only than Ritalin, but I gotta say, this is way stronger than Ritalin that is for sure. Also made myself a vitamin-electrolyte drink to get my electrolytes, and smoked a cigarette.
T+0:15 - Just listening to some Czech rap and I gotta say, the music enhancement on this thing is very intense, it produces really warm and comfortable euphoria in my body, and I am overall really enjoying this experience so far. Though the dry mouth is really annoying, gotta be honest with you.
T+0:20 - Checked my heart rate, I'm at 70BPM, which I find odd, because my average heart rate is approx. 80-90BPM.. That's weird, but I don't mind it, I actually like that, I don't like when my heart rate is fast for long periods of time, I get anxious and paranoid. Also the teeth grinding is hitting crazy, the urge to slam my teeth to the music rhythm is very strong, fucked up teeth.
T+0:25 Just started playing Roblox out of nowhere, just to kill the boredom, haven't played that in a while, definitely more enjoyable than sober.
T+0:30 - Feeling great, but suddenly, I feel vibrating senses in my legs, I get dizzy and me, confused, anxious, I say... Wtf is happening?
T+0:30 - Feeling great, but suddenly, I feel vibrating senses in my legs, I get dizzy and me, confused, anxious, I say... Wtf is happening?
Am I having a seizure?! I start being extremely anxious, scared, confused and paranoid that I'm gonna have a seizure. I start to feel pressure on my chest, my vision got blurry really quickly that I could not even read, I start to feel very dizzy second by second and my heart rate instantly came up to 128BPM.. I quickly got up from my chair and went rushing into my living room because there's better air in there, and went to get some water as I'm clearly not feeling well and need to rehydrate.
T+0:35 - Sitting on my couch in the living room, making my protein shake, and grabbing some grape sugars, texted my experienced friend and he said some tips to me, so we figured it out - malnutritioned & dehydrated, took really big lines with overly high doses for long periods of time (don't do that with 2-MMC). So I just went to make myself some cream raspberry protein shake, get all that vitamins B and C into me and hydrate well with some fresh filtered and cold water. Also some sugars, I came to the conclusion that I definitely had a panic attack and a delirium episode.
T+1:00 - I'm fine now, still feeling a bit dizzy but its manageable, the positive effects didn't wear off yet, but they're less enjoyable because I am still in shock from this.
T+1:20 - Not sure, but I think it may or may not be coming down, starting to feel less energized, but what is amazing about this, it doesn't have a crash, but rather a smooth and clear comedown, really craving a hit right now but not sure if I want to as I am still in shock from that, never really experienced something like this.
T+1:25 - The euphoria has definitely overtook the stimulation, still a bit energized gotta say, but definitely coming down right now.
T+1:30 - Really thinking about another hit, just a one small line would not hurt, right? Okay yeah, I'm gonna smoke my cigarette and do another hit.
T+1:35 - Snorted another line, I'd say about a 20 milligrams, burning like shit again, even such a small dose, but the burning definitely pays off.
T+1:40 - And the stress from the delirium episode is away. Clear headed now, euphoric and happy. I noticed every time I snort this, my vision is blurry, probably has to do something with the pupil dilation, I'm also dizzy on this, every time, which I don't get why I am, but I don't care about that so much, just focused on the good stuff. :P
T:1:50 - Feeling good so far, don't know which games to play, just listening to music and web surfing, I have the say this is by far the most enjoyable substance I've ever taken, and I don't get why it isn't more popular. Very, very underrated chemical in my opinion.
T=1:55 - Again, having that short-wave of relaxation and sedation all of a sudden, this is very paradoxical, it happens kind of often for me.
T+2:05 - Yawn. I'm feeling pretty sober, my body is not proud of me for this... I am pretty tired as well, I am gonna hit one last line.
T+2:10 - Snorted another approx. 20-30 milligrams, my right eye is tearing from the burning, I hate that feeling lol.
T+2:15 - It doesn't seem to hit that much as before, but I get it, my body is tired, not gonna take anymore today probably, I want to have some for yesterday also, so yeah, I'm going to smoke another cigarette and end the report here, because my body has enough, just don't binge on this stuff please, it is really not good for you and eventually your body will be really fatigued and as a result you will end up in confusion and delirium, and I am not even talking about a higher risk for psychosis.
This was my experience with 2-MMC, or Ortomephedrone, overall I'd say it's a great, very underrated and unknown stimulant, to experience something new or just have fun, I haven't tried any other methods than insufflating, but I'd stick to the snorting just because it is the most intense way and lasts the longest than for example, smoking or taking it orally. Definitely does not have a crash like Ritalin, rather a smooth and a calm comedown, the after effects I experienced were nothing crazy as well, just physically fatigued and unmotivated, classics.
I used this substance pretty often to study, and it wasn't the best, just because the memory suppression on it is really intense, it gives me a enjoyable high, perfect for raves or any other music-involved activities, I really enjoy music on this thing, yeah. Just don't make the same mistakes I did, definitely don't starve yourself; even though I was not hungry, my body was fatigued and it needed nutrition.
